name: web-content-blocker
description: MV3 extension that blocks search results by keyword or site across every search type.

scripts.build: pnpm bump && pnpm clean && pnpm icons && vite build && vite build --config vite.content.config.ts
scripts.build:noversion: pnpm clean && pnpm icons && vite build && vite build --config vite.content.config.ts
scripts.watch: pnpm icons && (vite build --watch & vite build --config vite.content.config.ts --watch & wait)
